import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source6_35_2 and Source6_35_0 on 'Artist'
join_0_2 = pd.merge(source2, source0, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Operation 2: JOIN Source6_35_1 and Source6_35_4 on 'Artist'
join_1_4 = pd.merge(source1, source4, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Operation 3: JOIN Source6_35_3 and Source6_35_5 on 'Artist'
join_3_5 = pd.merge(source3, source5, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Operation 4: JOIN Source6_35_6 and Source6_35_7 on 'Artist'
join_6_7 = pd.merge(source6, source7, on="Artist", how="inner")

# Operation 5: UNION all joined tables on 'Artist' and all other columns
# Before union, ensure all joined tables have the same columns and order

# Columns expected after join and union (from target schema):
# ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By',
#  'Influenced', 'Certified Units (Millions)', 'Albums in RS500', 'Top 100 Singles',
#  'Highest Position', 'Times on Cover of RS', 'Score', 'Spotify']

# Prepare each joined dataframe to have all columns, filling missing columns with NaN

def prepare_df(df):
    # Add missing columns with NaN
    columns = ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By',
               'Influenced', 'Certified Units (Millions)', 'Albums in RS500', 'Top 100 Singles',
               'Highest Position', 'Times on Cover of RS', 'Score', 'Spotify']
    for col in columns:
        if col not in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.NA
    # Reorder columns
    return df[columns]

df0 = prepare_df(join_0_2)
df1 = prepare_df(join_1_4)
df3 = prepare_df(join_3_5)
df6 = prepare_df(join_6_7)

# UNION all four dataframes (concatenate rows)
target_df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df3, df6], ignore_index=True)

# Data type conversions according to target schema
target_df['Artist'] = target_df['Artist'].astype(str)

# Convert integer columns, allowing for NaNs (use Int64 dtype for nullable integers)
int_cols = ['Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Influenced',
            'Albums in RS500', 'Top 100 Singles', 'Highest Position', 'Times on Cover of RS', 'Spotify']
for col in int_cols:
    target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Convert float columns
target_df['Certified Units (Millions)'] = pd.to_numeric(target_df['Certified Units (Millions)'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
target_df['Score'] = pd.to_numeric(target_df['Score'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# 'Inducted By' is string, convert and fill NaN with empty string
target_df['Inducted By'] = target_df['Inducted By'].astype(str).replace('nan', pd.NA)

# Save the final target dataframe to CSV
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_35/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
